text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap*)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, that girl...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shutter clicked during the run. Looking 
over, there stood a young girl aiming a 
large camera right at Bubble Gum Fellow.
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry. Could you refrain from taking 
photos right now?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I-I'm so sorry! Taking a photo 
without your permission... —Ugh, what was 
I thinking...?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! I don't mind at all. That's a 
nice camera. Do you like taking photos?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... I'm sorry. Your running form 
was so beautiful that before I knew it, I 
just couldn't help pressing the shutter, 
so to speak...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Um... I promise I'll delete the photo 
data! I'll submit a different picture for 
the student contest...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A student contest? Ooh, sounds fun! In 
that case, feel free to use my photos! No 
need to hold back!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, a jersey against a guardrail is 
kind of subtle, huh. Trainer, could I ask 
you for a favor?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Alright, I'll 
run around here, so snap away however you 
like. If you have any specific shots in 
mind, just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? U-Um... are you sure? Aren't we in 
the middle of training right now...?
choice_data_list:
It's okay. I just switched to checking my 
form instead

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, exactly! In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Amazing...! It's so pretty...! 
......!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap! Snap, snap! Click-click-click—!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing at the girl frantically snapping 
photos with her camera, I watched Bubble 
Gum Fellow run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, an hour had passed before 
they knew it. Bubble Gum Fellow kept 
running, and the girl frantically snapped 
photos, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plink, plink... shhhhh)
choice_data_list: Rain...! Let's take a break for now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: How's that? Did you get a good photo?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
...I can't do it. I'm sorry. Even after 
all that running you did for me... At this 
rate, I won't even place... Ugh, waahh...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"You seem really stressed out. Is 
something bad gonna happen if you don't 
place?"

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Actually... my parents told me that if I 
don't win an award at the next student 
contest, I have to give up on being a 
photographer and go to a normal 
university...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Still, the photography department... I 
just can't give up on it... And yet, 
uuu... it even had to start raining...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see. Leave it to me, then! I won't let 
her give up on her dream, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
B-But...! The deadline is tomorrow. If we 
can't shoot now, there's no way we'll make 
it...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, let me declare it right now. I will 
make sure you take an award-winning photo. 
Without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text: "Definitely...? Ah...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if Bubble Gum Fellow's declaration 
reached the heavens, the clouds parted in 
that very moment, restoring the blue. A 
grand rainbow stretched across the vast 
sky.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Click-click-click... snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is our last chance. We head back to 
the outdoor track and resume shooting. And 
after filming for a few more minutes, 
finally—!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text: Ah... Just now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn in by the young girl, I peer at the 
camera screen. Captured there was Bubble 
Gum Fellow's beaming smile as he ran, 
beautiful and swift, kicking up droplets 
from the grass—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, as I was waiting at the 
school gates with Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san, Trainer-san! Um, um! I managed 
to place...! Look... this is my 
certificate!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, amazing! Congratulations! See? It 
turned out just like I predicted, didn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
"Really...?! But how did you do it? Why 
did you say 'without a doubt' back 
then...?"
choice_data_list:
It's because you didn't give up and kept 
working hard.

It's because you never gave up and kept 
doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
"Really...?! But how did you do it? Why 
did you say 'without a doubt' back 
then...?"
choice_data_list:
It's because you didn't give up and kept 
working hard.

It's because you never gave up and kept 
doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, yeah. Because I knew for sure 
that you could do it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Make your dream of becoming a photographer 
come true. Our paths may differ, but let's 
whip up a whirlwind beyond our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
N-Yes...! Just like Bubble-san, I'll give 
it my all with a "can do, will do" 
mindset! I won't ever give up again!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's go totally wild!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just like you said, Trainer! I may have 
been the one running, but you were the one 
who clicked the shutter, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for taking such cool photos of my 
running! I was so moved when you showed 
them to me!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
No way...! But thanks to you, Bubble-san, 
I've gained a bit of confidence. If I 
believe I can do it, a rainbow will 
appear, and placing in the top ranks will 
come true...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Cherish those big 
dreams of yours, and become a wonderful 
photographer one day!
